edges.reason: withdrawAll executes a low-level send of the entire balance before any state update.
withdrawAll uses the caller-controlled msg.sender as the ETH recipient.
msg.sender must equal owner() for withdrawAll to proceed, gating the balance transfer.
pauseAllMarket writes the global allPaused flag.
setMarketStatus overwrites marketList entries and is restricted by onlyOwner.
startRoundSale unpauses the round market entry in marketList.
startRoundSale initializes the round counter to 1.
startRoundSale stores the current block number in startRoundBlock.
setBlockPerRound mutates the round duration and is owner-gated.
setBaseURI rewrites _baseTokenURI and is owner-gated.
_baseURI reads the stored _baseTokenURI state variable.
getPredictRoundPrice reads the round market price from marketList.
getPredictRoundPrice scales the price by roundSalePerRound using percentage arithmetic.
getMarketInfo returns fields read from the marketList mapping.
constructor populates all three marketList entries with initial price and cap values.
setNextRound calls getPredictRoundPrice to derive the next round price.
setEmergencyNextRound calls getPredictRoundPrice to derive the next round price.
setNextRound updates the round market price in marketList.
setNextRound increments the round counter.
setNextRound resets roundSalePerRound to zero.
setNextRound advances startRoundBlock by blockPerRound.
setEmergencyNextRound is owner-only and rewrites the round market price.
setEmergencyNextRound resets roundSalePerRound.
preMint delegates the actual minting to mulitpleMint.
timeAttackMint delegates the actual minting to mulitpleMint.
roundMint delegates the actual minting to mulitpleMint.
roundMint calls setNextRound when the attempt countdown has elapsed.
roundMint reads blockPerRound to decide whether the round must roll over.
roundMint compares startRoundBlock against the current block number.
mulitpleMint calls _generateRandomIndex for every token it mints.
mulitpleMint uses _safeMint, invoking the external onERC721Received callback on contract recipients before supply accounting settles.
_generateRandomIndex derives its output from manipulable block and caller entropy.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random seed, letting the caller influence the result.
block.timestamp is hashed into the pseudo-random seed, making the result miner-influenceable.
_generateRandomIndex performs modular index computation and swap writes on the indices array.
_generateRandomIndex increments the nonce after selecting an index.
preMint._count parameter is consumed by the preMint sale validation and minting.
timeAttackMint._count parameter is consumed by the time-attack sale validation and minting.
roundMint._count parameter drives the round cap check and mint quantity.
mulitpleMint._count parameter bounds the internal minting loop.
pauseAllMarket._paused parameter is written into the allPaused state variable.
setMarketStatus._price parameter is written into marketList.
setMarketStatus._saleCount parameter is written into marketList.
setMarketStatus._maxAmount parameter is written into marketList.
setBlockPerRound._blockPerRound parameter is written into blockPerRound.
walletOfOwner._owner parameter selects which balance and enumeration results are returned.
setBaseURI.baseURI parameter is written into _baseTokenURI.
constructor._initialMint parameter bounds the constructor mint loop.
constructor._to parameter is the recipient of the initial mint batch.
preMint._to parameter becomes the recipient passed to mulitpleMint.
roundMint._to parameter becomes the recipient passed to mulitpleMint.
generateRandomIndex.totalSize local variable supplies the modulus for the random index.
generateRandomIndex.index local variable holds the selected permutation slot.
generateRandomIndex.value local variable is the token index returned to the caller of the mint.
setNextRound.nextRoundPrice local variable is compared and clamped in the price update.
walletOfOwner.tokenCount local variable sizes the returned token id array.
walletOfOwner.tokensId local variable accumulates the enumerated token ids.

normalization_plan.reason: Scalar quantity parameter only meaningful inside preMint; folds into the preMint function node.
Scalar quantity parameter only meaningful inside timeAttackMint.
Scalar quantity parameter only meaningful inside roundMint.
Scalar quantity parameter drives the internal mint loop of mulitpleMint.
Boolean toggle parameter is written directly into state by pauseAllMarket.
Owner price parameter is assigned into marketList by setMarketStatus.
Owner counter parameter is assigned into marketList by setMarketStatus.
Owner cap parameter is assigned into marketList by setMarketStatus.
Duration parameter is written into blockPerRound by setBlockPerRound.
Queried address parameter only scopes the read-only enumeration of walletOfOwner.
URI string parameter is written into _baseTokenURI by setBaseURI.
Mint count parameter only bounds the constructor initialization loop.
Recipient parameter only scopes the constructor mint batch.
Recipient parameter is forwarded by preMint into mulitpleMint.
Recipient parameter is forwarded by roundMint into mulitpleMint.
Intermediate permutation slot local used only inside _generateRandomIndex.
Return local of _generateRandomIndex, carries no independent semantics.
Modulus local computed from MAX_NFTS and totalSupply inside _generateRandomIndex.
Temporary price local used only within setNextRound.
Balance-derived array size local used only within walletOfOwner.
Return array accumulator local used only within walletOfOwner.
